name: Phiki
description: PHP port of Shiki using TextMate grammars and VS Code themes

host-language.comment: Pure PHP library. v2.x requires PHP ^8.2 and ext-mbstring; the 3.0 betas require PHP ^8.3.

form-factor.comment: Composer library with no CLI binary (`bin` is unset in composer metadata). First-party adapters for league/commonmark, Laravel (facade and Blade component) and Statamic ship inside the same package.

license.comment: MIT. The bundled grammars and themes come from Shiki's tm-grammars and tm-themes collections (credited in the README) and keep their upstream licences.

documentation.comment: phiki.dev serves 3.x docs by default; the 2.x docs live under /2.x/.

first-release.comment: Repo created 2024-09-23; first Packagist tag v0.0.1 on 2024-10-04.

latest-version.comment: Latest stable is v2.2.1 (2026-07-22). Pre-release v3.0.0-beta2 came out 2026-11-16, and the default branch is 3.x. Checked 2026-11-19. Unless noted, the values in this file reflect 2.2.1.

engine-model.comment: Interprets TextMate grammars with a tokenizer modelled on vscode-textmate (StateStack, ScopeStack, injections), then applies VS Code themes.

regex-engine.comment: In 2.x, patterns run through mbstring's mb_ereg_search_* functions, which use Oniguruma (C). 1.x used PCRE. The 3.0 betas add a PCRE engine (preg_*, with pre-translated grammars) that is used as a fallback when mbregex is unavailable. Not counted here because 3.x is still pre-release.

embedded-languages.comment: Cross-grammar includes and TextMate injection selectors are resolved by scope (GrammarRepository::getFromScope, Grammar/Injections). The compatibility report shows the html and vue samples matching vscode-textmate tokens exactly (measured on 3.x).

language-auto-detection.comment: No content-based detection. The upgrade guide recommends always specifying the language.

filename-extension-mapping.comment: The Grammar enum has only name aliases (e.g. js, cs, f90), plus user aliases through Phiki::alias(). There is no filename, extension, shebang or MIME lookup API.

resumable-line-state.comment: Tokenizer::tokenize(string) always tokenizes the whole input. The StateStack rule stack exists internally but is not accepted or returned by any public API.

incremental-reparsing.comment: Full re-tokenization on every call. Output can be cached via PSR-16, but that is not incremental reparsing.

semantic-distinctions.comment: TextMate regex grammars only, with no syntax tree. Function-definition scopes come from grammar regexes, which the guideline counts as false.

bundled-languages.comment: 2.x Grammar enum has 228 cases. Excluding the synthetic `txt` and `ansi` leaves 226; aliases are not counted. The docs list shows only 218 because it is stale (it misses antlers, djot, hurl, kdl, maml, neon, pkl, rosmsg). Checked 2026-11-19.

grammar-format.comment: Grammars are JSON TextMate files, loaded from a path or passed as a PHP array to Grammar::parse().

grammar-ecosystem-compatibility.comment: Bundles the tm-grammars collection (the same as Shiki's) and accepts any VS Code TextMate JSON grammar. On the 3.x PCRE engine, custom grammars must use PCRE syntax or be converted with OnigurumaToPcre.

runtime-grammar-loading.comment: Phiki::grammar($name, $pathOrParsedGrammar) registers a grammar from a file or an inline array at runtime.

lazy-grammar-loading.comment: GrammarRepository::get() reads and parses a grammar's JSON file the first time it is requested, then memoizes it.

grammar-accuracy.comment: Grammars track upstream VS Code/tm-grammars. Remaining divergence comes from the PHP interpreter, not the grammars. The 3.x compatibility report (Oniguruma engine) has 152 of 227 sample grammars token-identical to vscode-textmate (97.1% of tokens), with typescript, rust, python and php at 99.6% to 100%. 3.0 notes that tokenization now follows vscode-textmate more closely, so 2.x diverges somewhat more. Rated 4 rather than 5 for that interpreter-level gap.

bundled-themes.comment: 60 Theme enum cases and 60 theme JSON files in 2.x. Checked 2026-11-19.

theme-format.comment: VS Code colour-theme JSON (`colors` + `tokenColors`), loaded from a file or an array.

token-classification.comment: Each token carries its array of TextMate scopes; AddClassesTransformer turns them into `phiki-<scope>` classes.

css-class-output.comment: Output is inline styles by default. The bundled AddClassesTransformer adds scope-based classes, and `styles: false` produces class-only output.

multi-theme-output.comment: Pass an array of themes to codeToHtml(): the first is the default and each other key gets `--phiki-{key}-*` CSS variables. Light/dark switching is done with user CSS (media query or class).

public-token-api.comment: Borderline. The public methods codeToTokens(), codeToHighlightedTokens() and tokensToHighlightedTokens() return token arrays, and the documented transformer hooks `tokens` and `highlighted` expose them. The docs site describes the Token/HighlightedToken stages but has no API-reference page for these methods.

ir-kinds.comment: Token(scopes[], text, start, end) and HighlightedToken(token, settings per theme). There is also an internal HTML AST ('Phast': Root/Element/Text), modifiable through transformer hooks. It mirrors hast but is PHP objects rather than unified's hast, so it is not tagged.

serializable-ir.comment: Tokens and the Phast AST are plain PHP objects with no documented JSON or other serialization.

theme-resolved-tokens.comment: codeToHighlightedTokens() returns HighlightedToken objects with resolved TokenSettings (colour, background, font style) per theme.

source-offsets-in-ir.comment: Token has public `start` and `end` offsets within the line.

custom-formatter-api.comment: No pluggable formatter interface. Transformers (TransformerInterface/AbstractTransformer) can rewrite tokens, the HTML AST and the final output, similar to Shiki's transformers; non-HTML renderers must be built on codeToHighlightedTokens().

line-transforms-decorations.comment: Pre, code, line and gutter decorations, plus transformers. The CommonMark adapter adds annotations (highlight/focus/diff-style) through meta and annotation transformers. Substring decorations are not supported yet.

output-formats.comment: HTML only. Class output comes from the bundled AddClassesTransformer. The 1.x terminal (ANSI) output was removed in 2.0. The `ansi` grammar does the reverse: it renders ANSI-escaped text to HTML.

line-numbers.comment: ->withGutter() adds line numbers; ->startingLine(n) sets the first number.

streaming-output.comment: PendingHtmlOutput renders the whole input at once in toString(). There is no line iterator.

terminal-ready.comment: Terminal output was removed in 2.0 for low usage and maintenance overhead.

native-dependencies.comment: Pure PHP with no third-party C libraries of its own. 2.x does require ext-mbstring with mbregex, i.e. the Oniguruma C library bundled with or linked by PHP's mbstring. Some PHP builds omit mbregex, and PHP 8.6 deprecates it, which is why 3.x adds a PCRE fallback.

synchronous-api.comment: All PHP calls are synchronous, with no async initialisation.

bindings-ports.comment: PHP only. Phiki is itself a port of Shiki's approach. The Laravel, Statamic and CommonMark adapters are same-language integrations, not bindings.

core-package-size.comment: v2.2.1 Composer dist zip (GitHub zipball) is 1,757,653 bytes. Extracted it is about 9.2 MB, mostly the bundled grammar and theme JSON under resources/. Measured 2026-11-19.

throughput-tier.comment: Reproducible maintainer benchmark (`composer performance`) on 3.x, with the same grammars and samples for all engines. Phiki takes 6.8x Shiki's time to highlight with Oniguruma and 5.9x with PCRE; tokenization is 8.5x (Oniguruma) and 7.4x (PCRE) vscode-textmate's. That is the 3-10x band, i.e. moderate. Measured on PHP 8.4 with OPcache and JIT off; 2.x numbers are not published.

initialization-cost.comment: Not measured: the benchmark explicitly excludes grammar loading and compilation.

monthly-downloads.comment: Packagist monthly installs, checked 2026-11-19. Total installs: 5.5M.

last-release.comment: v2.2.1 is the latest stable. Pre-releases v3.0.0-beta1 (2026-11-04) and beta2 (2026-11-16) are not counted.

maintenance-status.comment: Regular 2.x releases through 2026 and 3.0 betas in Nov 2026 (last push 2026-11-16). No open issues at check time.

documentation-quality.comment: Dedicated versioned docs site with guides, a grammar/theme catalog and upgrade guides (2.0, 3.0). There is no API reference: token-level methods are undocumented and the grammar list is stale. Rated 4 rather than 5 for these gaps.

notable-users.value: Torchlight Engine, LaRecipe, Prezet, Filament plugins (filament-log-viewer, filament-knowledge-base)
notable-users.comment: torchlight/engine requires phiki ^2, binarytorch/larecipe ^2.2, and prezet/prezet ^2.2 (Prezet is also listed on the docs site). Top dependents by downloads were checked 2026-11-19.

bus-factor.comment: Ryan Chandler has 204 of about 232 commits; every other contributor has 5 or fewer.
